info.title: DriveCore Backend API
info.description: DriveCore operational API through M7: scoped reservations/rentals/documents, driver assignment, extensions, quotations, discount approvals, company financial settings and private server PDF exports. Invoice/payment/accounting workflows and later milestones are not implemented in this version.

Search is case-insensitive literal substring; filters and sort are applied before pagination. Requires documents.view, or driver role restricted to documents linked to assigned rentals. Search original_name and mime_type. entity_id requires entity_type. Unsupported future entity types have no rows until those modules exist. post.description: Requires documents.manage. entity_type and entity_id must be supplied together, or both omitted/null. Target must be accessible in the exact company and branch. Only vehicle/customer/reservation/rental targets exist in M6; quotation/invoice uploads return 422 until those modules are implemented. Drivers may upload only against assigned rentals; unrelated/unlinked documents are denied. Multipart identifiers are returned as JSON integers.

patch.summary: Update user access in a company
patch.description: Requires users.manage and whole-company access. company_id is required in JSON. Only role, branch_id and is_active may change. Self access changes return 409. Company administrators cannot change global roles or activation for multi-company users (409), or manage platform accounts (404). Platform administrators may change global access for multi-company users. Deactivation revokes personal access tokens; existing sessions are denied by active-account middleware. Role assignments are global in this version.
